i agree that we should have member commitment sections before leaving sections... but i think it makes sense to have "From One Community to a Movement" right after founderism since that's an antidote to founderism, and i'm unsure about absorption and membership, because that seems like it maybe should come just inside or just under the section of practicing community, since that's where i'm first talking about whether people can actually live together or not, --- like there should be a sequence of steps that make sense in terms of the decision making and life changing process so that we are changing out lives in the steps that come directly after each other and make most sense to think about in order... open to your ideas...

and when you are giving advice on moving sections or showing the changes, you should include an interactive visual diagram so it's easy for the owner at a glance to see the proposed changes or changes made, and some more details about the pros/cons of the resequencing & why the pros outweighed the cons to you (perhaps depending on what audience the owner is targeting or other factors, you could ask if unsure). 
this is what humans probably need the most help with, because it's hard for us to have such a large "context window" to think about overall organization. we use outlines for that reason, which include not just the heading titles but the purpose of each section and the links and dependencies between the sections, subsections, and main ideas inside. but it's hard for us to work based entirely on the outline since we are also writing within the thoughts themselves. so then re-mapping to the outline is difficult. i am surprised that so far i feel like ia m better than AI often times at figuring out where to place the sections, because that is mainly what i need AI to help me with. so maybe you need some better strategy brainstorming for this...
